name: Forecast year label
explanation_20_words: Adds one year to the prior column’s fiscal-year label so forecast headers stay sequential.

name: Balance sheet check
explanation_20_words: Flags ERROR if Assets ≠ L+E by more than $1k; otherwise OK. Protects the plug.

name: COGS %
explanation_20_words: FY25 COGS divided by FY25 revenue, held flat so gross margin matches latest reported mix.

name: SG&A %
explanation_20_words: Normalized FY25 SG&A% after stripping restructuring, minus 75bps×year, floored at 15%.

name: R&D %
explanation_20_words: FY25 R&D over FY25 revenue, held flat so product investment scales with sales.

name: D&A % of Avg PP&E
explanation_20_words: FY25 DA/PPE rate; dollars use average PP&E so CapEx additions are depreciated.

name: Interest % of debt
explanation_20_words: FY25 interest over opening debt approximates the book coupon; 5% fallback if no debt.

name: Tax % of EBT
explanation_20_words: FY25 tax over FY25 EBT is the effective book rate; 21% statutory fallback if EBT zero.

name: Operating NWC % of Sales
explanation_20_words: Flat NWC/Sales for asset-light software; kills gross-AR/deferred double-count drain.

name: AP days
explanation_20_words: Accounts payable over COGS × 365 from FY25; payable timing for operating NWC.

name: CapEx % fade
explanation_20_words: Blends FY25 CapEx/Sales toward 1% steady so peak capitalized software does not persist.

name: Revenue
explanation_20_words: Prior-year revenue grown by this year’s policy growth rate; top-line driver of the model.

name: COGS $
explanation_20_words: Revenue times COGS%; converts the held margin assumption into dollar cost of sales.

name: Gross profit
explanation_20_words: Revenue minus COGS; contribution after direct cost of revenues before operating expenses.

name: SG&A $
explanation_20_words: Revenue times SG&A%; operating opex after the −75bps efficiency grind on the rate.

name: R&D $
explanation_20_words: Revenue times R&D%; research spend scales with sales at the FY25 reinvestment rate.

name: D&A $
explanation_20_words: Average PP&E times DA% so new CapEx is depreciated in the year added.

name: Interest $
explanation_20_words: Opening debt times interest%; coupon on the debt stock while issuance policy is zero.

name: Total expenses
explanation_20_words: Sum of SGA, R&D, D&A, and interest; all operating and financing costs above EBT.

name: EBT
explanation_20_words: Gross profit minus total expenses; earnings before tax in this simplified template.

name: Taxes $
explanation_20_words: EBT times effective tax rate; book tax expense for the income statement.

name: Net earnings
explanation_20_words: EBT kept after tax; full equation, not a pointer, so NI tracks the tax rate driver.

name: Cash (BS)
explanation_20_words: Balance-sheet cash equals cash-flow closing cash so the three statements stay linked.

name: AR $
explanation_20_words: Revenue × AR days / 365; receivables from the days-sales-outstanding assumption.

name: Inventory $
explanation_20_words: COGS × inventory days / 365; stays zero because inventory days are policy zero.

name: PP&E (BS)
explanation_20_words: Net PP&E equals the PPE schedule closing balance after CapEx and depreciation.

name: Total assets
explanation_20_words: Cash + AR + inventory + PP&E; simplified asset base used for the balance-sheet check.

name: AP $
explanation_20_words: COGS × AP days / 365; payables funded by the payable-days assumption.

name: Debt (BS)
explanation_20_words: Debt equals the debt-schedule closing balance (open + issuance, issuance usually 0).

name: Total liabilities
explanation_20_words: Accounts payable plus debt; simplified liability total in this teaching template.

name: Equity capital
explanation_20_words: Prior equity capital plus equity issued/(repurchased); policy keeps issuance at zero.

name: Retained earnings
explanation_20_words: Prior RE plus this year’s net earnings; accumulates NI into equity without dividends.

name: Shareholders’ equity
explanation_20_words: Equity capital plus retained earnings; book equity for the L+E side of the check.

name: Total L+E
explanation_20_words: Liabilities plus equity; must equal total assets when the model is in balance.

name: BS imbalance
explanation_20_words: L+E minus assets; should be ~0. Nonzero means a link or plug is broken.

name: CF net earnings
explanation_20_words: Same NI equation as the IS, written out so CFO does not hide behind a bare pointer.

name: CF + D&A
explanation_20_words: Adds back non-cash D&A on average PP&E in the cash-from-operations bridge.

name: CF − ΔNWC
explanation_20_words: ΔNWC from GrossAR+Inv−AP−Deferred; increase uses cash in the CFO build.

name: Cash from operations
explanation_20_words: Full CFO: NI + avg-PPE D&A − ΔNWC written as one equation.

name: CapEx $
explanation_20_words: Revenue times CapEx%; investing outflow used in CF and the PPE roll-forward.

name: Cash from investing
explanation_20_words: In this template CFI is CapEx only; equals the CapEx dollar line above.

name: Debt issuance CF
explanation_20_words: Pulls the debt issuance/(repayment) policy into financing cash flow.

name: Equity issuance CF
explanation_20_words: Pulls the equity issuance/(buyback) policy into financing cash flow.

name: Cash from financing
explanation_20_words: Debt plus equity financing cash; both policies are zero in the base case.

name: Δ Cash
explanation_20_words: CFO minus CapEx plus financing; net change that rolls opening cash to closing.

name: Opening cash
explanation_20_words: Starts at prior balance-sheet cash so the cash roll-forward matches history.

name: Closing cash
explanation_20_words: Opening cash plus Δ cash; feeds BS cash and the cash-flow check.

name: Cash check
explanation_20_words: Closing CF cash minus BS cash; must be zero when statements are linked.

name: WC: Gross AR
explanation_20_words: WC gross AR mirrors BS gross AR used in standard DSO.

name: WC: Inventory
explanation_20_words: Working-capital inventory mirrors BS inventory (zero for this software business).

name: WC: AP
explanation_20_words: Working-capital AP mirrors BS AP so NWC uses the same operating balances.

name: WC: Deferred Revenue
explanation_20_words: Contract liability projected at FY25 deferred/sales; separate from AR.

name: Net working capital
explanation_20_words: GrossAR + inventory − AP − Deferred; standard operating NWC.

name: Change in NWC
explanation_20_words: Year-over-year NWC change; the cash investment/(release) used in CFO and FCFF.

name: PPE opening
explanation_20_words: Prior closing PP&E (FY1 opens at last historical I44); base for CapEx and D&A.

name: PPE + CapEx
explanation_20_words: Same CapEx dollars as CF; additions that grow the gross PP&E stock.

name: PPE − D&A
explanation_20_words: Depreciation on average PP&E; reduces net PP&E and adds back in FCFF.

name: PPE closing
explanation_20_words: Open + CapEx − D&A; closing net PP&E posted to the balance sheet.

name: Debt opening
explanation_20_words: Prior closing debt (FY1 opens at historical I49); base for interest and issuance.

name: Debt issuance
explanation_20_words: Links the debt policy row into the schedule; base case keeps this at zero.

name: Debt closing
explanation_20_words: Open plus issuance/(repayment); closing debt posted to the balance sheet.

name: Interest (schedule)
explanation_20_words: Opening debt × interest%; same economics as IS interest, from the debt schedule.

name: WACC
explanation_20_words: Pulls the live CAPM WACC from the baked CAPM block so discounting uses researched Ke/Rd.

name: EBIT
explanation_20_words: Operating profit before interest/tax: gross profit minus SGA, R&D, and D&A from the 3S.

name: Unlevered tax
explanation_20_words: Taxes as if all-equity financed; uses DCF tax rate on EBIT for capital-structure-neutral FCFF.

name: D&A add-back
explanation_20_words: Adds non-cash depreciation from the 3-statement into unlevered free cash flow.

name: CapEx
explanation_20_words: Subtracts growth CapEx linked from the 3-statement investing line.

name: ΔNWC
explanation_20_words: Subtracts the cash used when operating working capital rises with revenue.

name: Unlevered FCF
explanation_20_words: FCFF available to debt and equity; the cash flow discounted in the DCF.

name: Exit TV
explanation_20_words: Terminal enterprise value at year 5 using exit EV/EBITDA (primary exit method).

name: Transaction CF
explanation_20_words: Periodic cash for XNPV: explicit FCFF each year; exit TV added in the terminal year.

name: Enterprise value
explanation_20_words: Present value of FCFF + TV using mid-year dates and the live WACC.

name: Equity value
explanation_20_words: Equity bridge: enterprise value plus cash minus gross debt (net debt adjustment).

name: Value / share
explanation_20_words: Intrinsic equity value per share using diluted shares outstanding.

name: WACC CAPM
explanation_20_words: Weighted average cost of capital from CAPM Ke and after-tax cost of debt.
